candidateDecisions.label: Ecology, Evolution and Conservation
candidateDecisions.assessment: The ecology direction develops biodiversity, evolutionary reasoning, ecosystem processes, marine biology and environmental analysis, including field and spatial tools.

candidateDecisions.label: Brain, Behavior and Biological Health
candidateDecisions.assessment: The neuroscience direction combines neural function and higher cognition with social and clinical psychology, physiological foundations and experimental evidence. The molecular plan already takes the biomedical direction through immunity, genetics and molecular disease.

analysis: The molecular plan develops basic cellular and organismal science before molecular cell biology, biochemistry and laboratory work, then human genetics, physiology, immunity and disease. The lab uses aseptic culture, DNA work and protein purification. Evolution establishes comparative foundations, while calculus, numerical methods, machine learning and late image processing and deep learning supply tools applicable to biological models and data. Generic data courses are not credited with a dedicated omics or bioinformatics sequence. The ecology plan progresses from biodiversity and ecosystem foundations to evolution, conservation, marine field and lab work, soil and water and environmental biogeochemistry. Earth Observation supplies GIS and remote-sensing evidence, and the description-only Earth’s Resources course adds geoscience research on resource and environmental pressures. Introductory data science precedes geospatial analysis. The stakeholder research course is offered only at entry and was replaced with later applied study. The behavior plan links life science and neurobiology to perception, higher cognition, social and clinical psychology, development, pharmacology and evidence synthesis. Psychopathology precedes assessment and therapies; this is academic study, not clinical qualification. The original language course is offered only before an appropriate perception and neuroscience sequence, and was replaced with more relevant progression. Molecular biology and behavior plans share foundations and differ by advanced computing and molecular lab work versus behavioral research and psychology. Ecology differs in organisms, environmental systems and methods. Eleven alignment rows identify shared content; broader general ethics, statistical learning and data analysis no longer stand in for specialist professional biology, biological modelling or bioinformatics. Groningen’s research project and specialist laboratory sequence remain visible.

alignment.rationale: Both introduce cell structure, inheritance and molecular mechanisms of life.
Both study how organ systems function and maintain physiological balance.
Both study the structure and function of biomolecules, including proteins, carbohydrates and lipids.
Groningen combines cell biology with microscopy. UCR covers cell structures, signaling and division in Molecular Cell Biology.
Both develop practical microbiology skills. UCR also uses protein and DNA techniques.
Both examine inheritance, gene regulation and genetic variation. UCR also studies how these mechanisms contribute to disease.
